title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy manifest-src allows a wildcard source
description: The Content-Security-Policy manifest-src directive contains a bare wildcard, so a web app manifest may come from any origin. The manifest decides the installed application identity, its icons and the start URL, which turns a document-level injection into a persistent client-side change.
applicability: HTTPS responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit manifest-src directive.
risk: Installed application identity can be altered by a third-party manifest; LOW severity because it needs a document injection and a user install step.
